content.comment_body: I've reviewed the [document] but couldn't find a clear answer. I'm trying to figure out if it's possible to use a 230RC [product_name] module with 5V DC input signals. I understand that the [product_name] requires higher voltages to register a HIGH signal. Since analog thresholds can be set with 24V, I'm wondering if this is also possible with the 230RC version.

The digital inputs on the 230 version of [product_name] do not support detection of 5VDC signals. The switching thresholds required for LOW and HIGH are higher (refer to [document] for details). Also, the 230 version does not have analog inputs. If you need to evaluate 5VDC signals with analog input capability, you would need the analog expansion module [product_name] AM2.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking clarification on input voltage requirements for the 230RC version of [product_name]. They note that documentation does not clearly explain the input voltage thresholds for both digital and analog signals. The core challenge is that the 230RC [product_name] cannot directly evaluate lower voltage signals nor does it offer analog input capability, making it less suitable for some applications.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is hoping for the 230RC [product_name] module to either directly support 5V DC digital inputs or for clear guidance on possible workarounds, such as using analog thresholds to accommodate lower input voltages.
